reviews.t: Curved handle and quality brush
reviews.x: I love the curve of the handle, I have a shoulder replacement and I just need a little help from that curve. Now, I can reach my entire back. The brush is perfect for using wet or dry. Pretty good quality. Very pleased

reviews.t: Does the job of teaching and cleaning
reviews.x: Great item for hard to reach back.  Bristle strength good!

reviews.t: Too Soft and Small Brush Head
reviews.x: It's so hard to find a good long handled shower brush that's durable. This brush is so soft that it's probably good for a newborn. The head is 1/3 the size of a normal back brush. The plastic handle seems to be made out of a durable plastic that won't break if dropped but the other cons outweigh this pro. I have tried wood handles which tend to crack or get black mold. Other plastic models are rigid plastic and shatter when dropped. The bristles on brushes are either too soft or you can scrap pa

reviews.t: Nice brush, but no way to hang it in the shower
reviews.x: So far we are just leaning it up in the corner of the tub edge.  I go back and forth between wooden brushes and plastic ones, as I can't decide which ones get grosser more quickly.  Wooden brushes always split with age.  I also flip back and forth between soft and firm bristles - can't decide which I like more.  This brush has soft bristles, which are a nice change from our old brush that had rather scratch bristles.  But I'll probably feel as though it's not "cleaning" enough after a bit.  It h

reviews.t: Well made and when/if it wears out will buy another
reviews.x: Like the length of the bath brush handle the soft but not wimpy bristles.  Would like the size of the head a little larger or my body smaller 🤭. All in all best bath brush I've had.

reviews.t: Good purchase!
reviews.x: Purchased this for my husband and have only had it a few days, but he says he likes the feel of the brushes and also the way the brush head is horizontal rather than vertical.

reviews.t: It wouldn’t end in the trash.
reviews.x: It has the right wheoght a shower brush should have.  And the way the bristles are constructed is perfect, and the head of the brush is ergonomically correct.

reviews.t: good for the price
reviews.x: finally it's wide enough and you can tie a string to it to stop it from slipping

reviews.t: Great shower brush!
reviews.x: I love this back brush!  Bristles are soft and the price was great!

reviews.t: Good soft brush
reviews.x: Like the softness of the brush. Handle is a good length.

reviews.t: Prefect brush
reviews.x: Perfect brush- soft enough to use as back brush too

reviews.t: Over the 35 years I've been using one, this is the best.
reviews.x: This is the easiest to use body brush or back brush that I've ever used. The bristles are not hard and painful on the skin, they seem to be a new material soft bristles but firm enough to really clean skin well. It's also a compact brush head not quite as large as the other ones I've used over the past 30 years. You can get into different spaces with this and it's easy to manipulate. Easy to use, very effective, gets the job done in less time with less energy! I love it! PS-I would say I actuall

reviews.t: Well made brush
reviews.x: Chose the white handle with light bristles, not sure how the dark ones would fare against mold at my shower which does not get a lot of sunlight. I am satisfied with the product, the bristles are packed with enough density to make a good lather. Also the bristles are firm but soft to the touch. Even though it was a “lighting deal” I found cheaper brushes at my local supermarket, would have been disappointed if bought at full price. Otherwise it’s a good product that checks all the boxes.

reviews.t: Works great, very soft and sudsy but the handle slips around if your hands are a little soapy
reviews.x: Works great. Very soft. It’s just difficult to handle in the shower if you hands happen to be a little soapy. The plastic handle is too smooth and doesn’t have any grip. You have to make sure to rinse you hands of any soap so you can have a firm  grasp to use it. Otherwise it’ll slip around

reviews.t: Best back brush I've ever tried.
reviews.x: Best back brush that I have ever used. Doesn't hurt. Dries well. I keep one for when my back is itchy. Relieves a back itch without any painful scratching. Many fine soft bristles clean my back comfortably and the handle is shaped well and is long enough to reach my back easily.

reviews.t: Reminded me of a sister's Barbie brush from long ago
reviews.x: The bristles are very soft, so don't expect a vigorous scrubbing. You can use it on your face, if you want.  Way too soft for my preferences, so I ordered a different one that I am happily using on a daily basis.  If I need to scrub behind my ears, I'll use this one.  Too soft.

reviews.t: Nice Brush!
reviews.x: I have used this bath brush for a while now and it is great. Its bristles are soft, yet firm enough to scrub you clean. The handle is easy grip/nonslip and is a good length. It works great. I am very happy with this purchase.

reviews.t: VERY SOFT (maybe too soft)
reviews.x: Bought this for my feet and back. Not curved enough to easily get your back, and not firm enough for either of my intended uses. Also, it would be nice if it came with a cord for easier hanging - but I rigged a zip tie :-)

reviews.t: Love the handle!
reviews.x: This product is built well and it works.  My only caveat would be is the bristles or brush would provide better service if they were a little firmer.  They  are so soft that you don’t get that skin scrub I was looking for.

reviews.t: DO NOT BUY --- You will not be able to hold it with soapy hands
reviews.x: Hi,  There is no grip on the handle. The handle is slippery.  It is very difficult to hold the brush with soap on your hands. I do not know what designers were thinking when they designed this brush.

reviews.t: DO NOT BUY --- You will not be able to hold it with soapy hands
reviews.x: Hi,  There is no grip on the handle. The handle is slippery.  It is very difficult to hold the brush with soap on your hands. I do not know what designers were thinking when they designed this brush.

reviews.t: Like It!
reviews.x: I was expecting the bristles to be like the plastic kind I had with my last shower brush.  These bristles are more like the feel you get from a loofa.  It works just as well and I like it.

reviews.t: Too Straight
reviews.x: The only complaints I have are that the handle is too straight and there is not a large enough brush area.  The brush is sturdy and the handle is long, it just needs to curve more.

reviews.t: Works, but not a spa item
reviews.x: Works. Looks like something my grandma in a nursing home would have. I got the white one, and it's made of the same material those shower chairs are made of. Not very spa-like.

reviews.t: Brush is inches shorter than listing
reviews.x: Listing noted this was 14 inches - when I received I measured it and it was a little over 11 inches.  Listing notes it as long but what you receive is not what listing states.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the soft yet effective bristles, saying they clean well without being painful.
Many customers find the handle length and curved shape make it easy to reach their entire back.
Several reviewers describe the brush as well made and good value for the price.
A few customers complain the brush head is too small or the bristles too soft.
Some reviewers note the smooth plastic handle slips when hands are soapy and there is no way to hang it.
